import itertools
import time

def compute_sum_c_sq(seq):
    n = len(seq)
    total = 0
    for k in range(1, n):
        ck = sum(seq[i] * seq[i+k] for i in range(n-k))
        total += ck * ck
    return total

start = time.time()
found = False

    s = list(bits)
    if compute_sum_c_sq(s) <= 49:
        print(s)
        found = True
        break
print("Found:", found)
print("Time:", time.time()-start)
